notifications.title: TwitchCon San Diego Firebot User Meetup
notifications.message: Hey, Firebot fans! TwitchCon San Diego is just a couple weeks away and we're considering hosting a TwitchCon Firebot User Meetup. If you're attending TwitchCon San Diego AND you'd be interested in attending a Firebot user meetup, either respond to our Discord poll or reply to zunderscore on Bluesky. Hope to see you there!

notifications.title: UPDATE: TwitchCon San Diego Meetup Details
notifications.message: Hey, Firebot fans. We weren't able to get a separate venue, so we're taking over the official Chat Moderators & Software Dev Community MeetUp at TwitchCon! For more details (and to see the exclusive Firebot sticker zunder will be giving out), check out either the Discord announcement or zunder's post on Bluesky. See you in San Diego!
